_note: Generated from opendpd.schemas.examples; do not edit by hand.

data.description: OpenDPD carrier ACLR and pooled error on valid samples; excludes evaluation padding.

metrics.formula: 10*log10( sum|y - r|^2 / sum|r|^2 ) over the valid range
metrics.name: NMSE

metrics.aggregation: pooled PSD over the valid range
metrics.formula: 10*log10( P_main(y - r) / P_main(r) ) with band powers from the Welch PSD
metrics.name: IBE
metrics.notes: Spectral error ratio inside the main channel; not a demodulated EVM. As an amplitude ratio it is 10^(IBE/20), as a percentage 100*10^(IBE/20).

metrics.name: ACLR_L
metrics.notes: Equal carrier bands of width bandwidth_hz / n_sub_ch. Negative leakage dBc; lower is better.

metrics.name: ACLR_R
metrics.notes: Equal carrier bands of width bandwidth_hz / n_sub_ch. Negative leakage dBc; lower is better.

parameters.aclr_average: arithmetic mean of left and right dBc, for historical OpenDPD checkpoint selection
parameters.aclr_reference: strongest integrated in-band carrier power; adjacent/reference in negative dBc
parameters.aggregation: pooled over the whole valid range (sums of powers); never the mean of per-segment dB values
parameters.band_power: sum over PSD bins whose centre frequency lies in [lo, hi) times the bin width fs/nperseg
parameters.capture_requirement: a band must lie inside [-fs/2, +fs/2); otherwise the metric is not_applicable
parameters.main_channel: [-B/2, B/2), divided into N = n_sub_ch equal carrier bands of width W = B/N
parameters.normalization: none: prediction and reference are compared as given (target = gain * input for DPD)
parameters.psd: scipy.signal.welch, two-sided, window=hann, nperseg=dataset nperseg, noverlap=nperseg//2, detrend off, scaling=density
parameters.units: NMSE and IBE are power-error ratios in dB. ACLR is adjacent-carrier / strongest in-band carrier power in negative dBc; lower is better.
parameters.valid_range: real samples of the evaluated split only; the zero padding of the last segment is excluded
